body.query: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?

raw_response.sql:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment AS segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ym.date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ym.date LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE c.segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND (ym.date LIKE '2012%' OR ym.date LIKE '2013%')
  GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
  segment,
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM yearly
ORDER BY pct_change DESC

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment AS segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ym.date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,

  FROM yearmonth ym

  WHERE c.segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM')
    AND c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND (ym.date LIKE '2012%' OR ym.date LIKE '2013%')
  GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
  segment,
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM yearly
ORDER BY pct_change DESC
